:::{#def-precision-rv}
#### Precision of a random variable

The **precision** $\precision$ of a random variable $\Outvar$
with nonzero [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) $\Var{\Outvar}$
is the reciprocal of $\Var{\Outvar}$:

$$\precision \eqdef \frac{1}{\Var{\Outvar}}$$
:::
